content.text:
We need answer user wants teach student by creating 3 demonstration pairs via tool. We need call show_transformed_input three times with valid inputs. Need understand rule and verifier. The verifier actually: finds connected components of same nonzero color (4-connected). Identifies components that are hollow rectangles (3x3+ border set exactly). Sorts rectangles by area desc. Then for every nonzero cell, if it is strictly inside any rectangle (not on border), output color = color of outermost enclosing rectangle found first in sorted list (largest area containing it strictly). Essentially nested groups: all cells inside outermost rectangle get recolored to outer color, including borders of inner rectangles and solid blocks, as long as nonzero. Zero remains zero. Standalone cells outside any rectangle unchanged.

Important: The verifier only considers each connected component of a single color. Nested rectangles of different colors are separate components. It identifies rectangles by component shape. It recolors nonzero cells inside the largest rectangle(s).
